title: Substitute $$y$$
text: Replace $$y$$ with $$2e^{\left(-x\right)}+x-1$$. Since all of $$y$$ is being subtracted, each of its three terms changes sign.

title: Simplify
text: This gives $$x-2e^{\left(-x\right)}-x+1$$, which simplifies to $$-2e^{\left(-x\right)}+1$$. That matches $$y'$$ from the first step, so the function is a solution.
